title: Root Application component id changes with the scan folder name
description: Without a configured project name, the scanner names the root Application component after the scanned folder (deterministic-scan.ts projectNameFromPath), and the name is part of its stable key, so the same commit scanned in two folders gives that component two ids (Jira DATAP-858). Expected: the key does not depend on the folder name; the display name may still be the folder name.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Spec features/folder-independent-ids.feature failed first (one component id differed between folders first-checkout and second-checkout). Fix: the root Application component, whose name comes from the project name or the scan folder, gets properties.name_from_project = true, and stableComponentKey uses the token <project> instead of the name. The display name is unchanged. The id of this one component changes once for every repository. jest 1679 passed; the 3 failing features (gold-import, canonical representation) also fail on develop without this change.
